name: smcta
description: SMCTA - Sistema de Mercado Comportamental y Trading de Activos (rediseño P2P v2, White-Label)

scripts.build:ui: npm run build:shared && npm run build:web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run build:web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n backend,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @smcta/backend" "npm run dev --workspace @smcta/web"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start --workspace @smcta/backend
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace @smcta/backend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:shared && npm run test:coverage --workspace @smcta/backend
